ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: Hello, Sue. Will you join me in some grocery shopping?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Привет, Сью. Сходишь со мной за продуктами?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: Of course! Hehe, a great chance to pick up some more snacks, too.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Конечно! Хе-хе, отличный шанс купить ещё чего-нибудь перекусить.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: I see. I think I understand, then. This could be called an opportunity.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Понятно. Тогда, думаю, я понимаю. Это можно назвать возможностью.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: Hey. Those are some unusual clothes...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: You're right. I wonder where she's from?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: А что насчёт того другого дела?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Peddler
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: Ah! Well, I'm sorry to report, but we're having some issues with selecting a location...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Ах! Простите, что сообщаю, но у нас возникли проблемы с выбором места...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: I see. Will you please get it done as quickly as you can?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Понятно. Не могли бы вы сделать это как можно быстрее?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: For our future plans, the acquisition of the land is a most important starting step.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Для наших планов на будущее приобретение земли — важнейший первый шаг.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: Boss? I guess that means she's someone important.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: I've got it! All that talk of plans... She's a boss of some secret organization!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Поняла! Все эти разговоры о планах... Она босс какой-то секретной организации!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: Hahaha... You've been reading too many comics again, Sue...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Ты опять слишком много комиксов начиталась, Сью...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Phew. Finally, everything is ready.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Уф. Наконец всё готово.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Sue, look. It's that woman we saw!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Сью, смотри. Это та девушка, которую мы видели!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Wow, you're right. The boss of a secret organization!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Да, ты права. Босс секретной организации!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Excuse me, sorry, but I've no recollection of starting any secret organizations.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Простите, извините, но я не припоминаю, чтобы создавала какие-либо секретные организации.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Uwah, you heard that? Sorry! Come on, Sue, you apologize too!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Ух, ты услышала? Прости! Давай, Сью, ты тоже извинись!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Ah, sorry. I just remember someone calling you "boss" and, you know...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Ах, прости. Я просто помню, как кто-то назвал тебя «боссом», и, ну...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: I see. I need to tell my subordinates to be more careful with what they call me.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Понятно. Нужно сказать подчинённым, чтобы аккуратнее выбирали, как меня называть.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Ah, sorry. I'm Corneria. Boss - that is, head - of the Corneria Enterprise.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Ах, простите. Я Корнерия. Босс — то есть глава — Компании Корнерии.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Corneria? We're...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Корнерия? Мы...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Lydie and Sue, I take it?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Лиди и Сью, я так понимаю?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Suelle is my name. Everyone just calls me Sue.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Сюэль — моё имя. Все зовут меня просто Сью.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Hahaha, yeah, Lydie and Sue it is. Nice to meet you.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Ха-ха-ха, да, это Лиди и Сью. Приятно познакомиться.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: One thing, Miss Corneria... Just what is it that your Enterprise does?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Ещё одно, мисс Корнерия... Чем же занимается ваша Компания?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: The way you say that, I have to say, it takes me back!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: То, как ты это говоришь... должна сказать, это навевает воспоминания!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: The Corneria Enterprise is the name of my shop. It's actually quite famous, in other lands.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: «Компания Корнерии» — название моего магазина. На самом деле он довольно известен в других землях.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: So I'm here doing some market research in order to expand into Adalet.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Так что я здесь провожу исследование, чтобы выйти на рынок Адалет.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Wow... I thought the boss just sat at a desk and looked at documents!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Ого... Я думала, босс просто сидит за столом и смотрит документы!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Hey, Sue! I'm sorry for my sister, she really is...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Эй, Сью! Прости за сестру, она правда...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: No, it's fine. In fact, most of the time, that's precisely what happens.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Нет, всё в порядке. На самом деле большую часть времени именно так и бывает.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: However, a move to a new market is best to be seen through by yourself.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Однако выход на новый рынок лучше всего вести самой.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: I'm just about to open a street stall to check the market for myself!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Я как раз собираюсь открыть уличный ларёк, чтобы лично проверить рынок!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Ah, that makes sense. In which case, will you show us what you are selling?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Ах, логично. Тогда покажешь нам, что продаёшь?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Yes, of course. I've got plenty of confidence in my lineup, I can tell you that!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Да, конечно. Я очень уверена в своём ассортименте, уж поверьте!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..original: Uwah! Your shop is packed with some of the best items I've seen!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..translation: Ух ты! Твоя лавка прямо ломится от таких крутых товаров! Я подобных вообще нигде не видела!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..original: Tell me about it. We could do some real fine synthesizing with some of those goodies!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..translation: И не говори! Мы могли бы отлично поработать над синтезом с некоторыми из этих полезных вещей!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..original: Synthesizing? Could it be that you are both alchemists?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..original: That's right. I guess you could tell that from hearing "synthesizing."
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..translation: Верно. Наверное, по слову «синтез» всё поняла.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..original: But of course. I see, so you're alchemists?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..translation: Ну конечно. Понятно, так вы алхимики?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..original: This might be a good business opportunity! Hehehe!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..translation: Это может быть хорошей деловой возможностью! Хе-хе-хе!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..original: I'm sure she just gave me a really creepy smile. No, I'm just imagining things, right?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..translation: Кажется, она только что одарила меня жуткой улыбкой. Нет, я просто воображаю, да?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: Corneria, do you have a problem? Maybe we can help you!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Корнерия, у тебя проблемы? Может, мы сможем помочь!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: We solve problems for everyone in the city! At least, that's what we tell ourselves.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Мы решаем проблемы всех в городе! По крайней мере, так мы себе говорим.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: Hehe, is that so? In which case, let me try out your services.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Хе-хе, правда? Тогда позвольте опробовать ваши услуги.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: I want to bring in new products from my hometown, but it's a bit too far away.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Я хочу привезти новинки из родного города, но он слишком далеко.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: Watches and autographs are one thing, but cakes and vegetables won't last the trip.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Часы и автографы — одно дело, а торты и овощи дорогу не переживут.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: I see. I wonder if we could do something with alchemy? Like, a portable ice room?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Понятно. Интересно, сможем ли мы что-то сделать алхимией? Например, портативную ледяную комнату?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: Oh, good idea. That would stop things from spoiling!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: О, хорошая идея. Тогда ничего не испортится!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: Yes. That sounds like quite a good idea. Can I hire you to make that?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Да. Звучит неплохо. Могу я нанять вас это сделать?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: Yes, leave it to us! We'll make it so you can bring in all the delicious cakes!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Да, оставь это нам! Сделаем так, чтобы ты могла привозить все вкусные торты!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: Ah, well, this is about more than cakes... no matter. I'll just wait and see what you manage.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Ах, ну, дело не только в тортах... ладно. Просто подожду и посмотрю, что у вас получится.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Oh, it's cold! I could even carry raw meat around using this!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Ой, холодно! С этим я даже сырое мясо могла бы носить с собой!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: That's great! Now we'll get all the cakes!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Замечательно! Теперь получим все торты!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Hehe, I do have to thank you somehow, don't I? What would be a fitting reward?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Хе-хе, мне ведь нужно как-то вас отблагодарить? Какая награда будет достойной?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Y-You don't have to do anything special, please. We don't need anything...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Т-тебе не нужно ничего особенного, пожалуйста. Нам ничего не нужно...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Trust is an important part of my business. I need to thank you somehow...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Доверие — важная часть моего дела. Мне нужно как-то вас отблагодарить...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Ah, I know what to do! I'll start my volume retail service!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Ах, знаю! Запущу услугу оптовых продаж!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Volume retail? What's that?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Оптовые продажи? Что это такое?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Here's the thing. I have a unique ability. Sue, will you lend me an item for a moment?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Дело вот в чём. У меня есть уникальная способность. Сью, одолжишь мне на минутку какую-нибудь вещь?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Sure. Here, what about this?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Конечно. Вот, а как насчёт этого?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Thank you. Haaaha, teyaaah! There, what do you think?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Спасибо! Ха-а-а... Получай! Ну как, что скажете?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: What! It multiplied? Are you some kind of magician?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Что! Оно размножилось? Ты какая-то волшебница?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: No, this is my power. I have the ability to copy objects.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Нет, это моя сила. Я умею копировать предметы.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Copy objects? I can't believe it. How is such a thing even possible?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Копировать предметы? Не верится. Как такое вообще возможно?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: It's a very rare power, apparently. It's made me very popular.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Судя по всему, это очень редкая сила. Она сделала меня очень популярной.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: I bet! Being able to copy items out of thin air like that? That's almost too convenient!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Ещё бы! Копировать предметы из воздуха? Это уж слишком удобно!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Very well, Corneria. Can we ask you to provide us with that volume retail, too?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Хорошо, Корнерия. Можем ли мы попросить тебя предоставить нам такие оптовые продажи?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Yes, of course. I'll give your requests priority, so feel free to pile them on me! No problem!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Да, конечно. Отдам вашим запросам приоритет, так что смело загружайте меня! Без проблем!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: System
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: <CLEG>[Tutorial] ~Volume Retail~<CLNR>
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: <CLEG>[Обучение] ~Оптовые продажи~<CLNR>

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: System
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: At Corneria's shop, you can have her increase the count of your items.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: В магазине Корнерии вы можете попросить её увеличить количество ваших предметов.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: System
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: This is done by copying items you already have. Their quality and properties will be identical.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Это делается копированием уже имеющихся у вас предметов. Их качество и свойства будут идентичны.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: System
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Register the item you want and after a short while it will appear on the shelves.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Зарегистрируйте нужный предмет, и через некоторое время он появится на полках.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: System
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: <CLR1>Using this service may prove a shortcut to becoming a truly great alchemist. Maybe!<CLNR>
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: <CLR1>Эта услуга может оказаться кратчайшим путём к тому, чтобы стать по-настоящему великим алхимиком. Возможно!<CLNR>

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: Hello, Corneria. Business seems to be booming!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: Hehehe! Is this because you've been bringing in those new products?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Хе-хе-хе! Это потому, что ты привозишь эти новинки?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: Yes. They're a big part of it. But my volume retail service is proving even more popular.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Да. Они — большая часть этого. Но услуга оптовых продаж оказывается ещё популярнее.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: I've limited the amount allowed to be copied each day, but I'm still packed with customers!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Я ограничила число копий в день, но клиентов всё равно полно!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: You've had to place a limit? I guess you can't be too convenient.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Тебе пришлось поставить лимит? Значит, слишком удобной быть нельзя.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: No, it's a question of my basic nature. If I copy too many things, well, it won't be pretty...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Нет, это вопрос моей природы. Если копировать слишком много... будет некрасиво...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: Not pretty? What do you mean?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Некрасиво? Что ты имеешь в виду?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: Hehe, that's still a secret. Keep on shopping here and eventually I'll tell you.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Хе-хе, это пока секрет. Продолжайте покупать здесь — и когда-нибудь расскажу.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: Gah, trying to run away? One thing, though, Corneria. Just don't push yourself too hard, alright?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Ага, решила сбежать от ответа? Но вообще, Корнерия... Ты только не перенапрягайся сильно, ладно?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: That's right. If you collapse from overwork then this will be all for nothing, after all!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Верно. Если ты свалишься от переутомления, всё это будет зря!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: Yes, I will be careful. This Ranking System, though, is a big business opportunity!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Да, буду осторожна. Но Система рангов ателье — большая возможность для торговли!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: I need to work hard, in order to make my enterprise even bigger!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Мне нужно трудиться, чтобы моя компания стала ещё больше!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: I can't find the shop they were talking about. Gah, where is it?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Не могу найти магазин, о котором говорили. Ах, где же он?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: S-Sorry? What made you shout like that?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: П-прости? Что заставило тебя так кричать?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Can I ask you one thing? Have you ever been a doll?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Могу я спросить об одном? Ты когда-нибудь была куклой?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Ah, sorry if that's weird! I just saw a doll that looked exactly like you, once...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Ах, прости, если это странно! Просто я однажды видела куклу, которая выглядела точно как ты...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Hehe, that's a surprise for me too. A doll made to look like me? By who?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Хе-хе, для меня это тоже сюрприз. Кукла, похожая на меня? Чья?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Although I have a pretty good idea. Fritz... I'm going to invoice you for this!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Хотя у меня есть довольно хорошая догадка. Фриц... Я выставлю тебе счёт за это!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Ugh? I don't think it was Dad. And how do you know my dad, anyway?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Ух? Не думаю, что это был папа. И вообще, откуда ты знаешь моего отца?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Yep, that's right! I'm Drossel! Nice to meet you!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Ага, верно! Я Дроссель! Приятно познакомиться!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Ah, I'm Corneria. I see, Fritz's daughter...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Ах, я Корнерия. Понятно, дочь Фрица...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: What are you doing here, anyway, Drossel? You've been wandering up and down for a while.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Что ты здесь вообще делаешь, Дроссель? Ты уже какое-то время ходишь взад-вперёд.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Ah, of course. I'm looking for a shop called the Corneria Enterprise.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Ах, конечно. Я ищу магазин под названием «Компания Корнерии».

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Hold on, the shop is called Corneria... And your name is Corneria? Which means!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Погоди, магазин называется Корнерия... А тебя зовут Корнерия? Значит!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Yes. The Corneria Enterprise is my store.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Yes! I heard you sell lots of wonderful things, so I had to come and check it out!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Да! Я слышала, ты продаёшь много замечательных вещей, так что пришлось зайти и проверить!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: I see. Then please, feel free to take a look around.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: I'll give you a discount, too, since you're Fritz's daughter.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: И сделаю тебе скидку — раз ты дочь Фрица.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: A music box? What a lovely sound.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: Ah, welcome. Tell me, girls. Have you ever heard this music before?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Ах, добро пожаловать. Скажите, девочки. Вы когда-нибудь слышали эту музыку раньше?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: No, I don't think so. Sue?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: Me neither. Is there some kind of secret to that music box?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: И я нет. Есть ли какой-то секрет у этой музыкальной шкатулки?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: Like, the music from it opens the door to a secret treasure?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Например, музыка из неё открывает дверь к тайному сокровищу?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: No. This music is a clue to the location of my father. The father I've never met.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Нет. Эта музыка — ключ к местонахождению моего отца. Отца, которого я никогда не встречала.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: No. He left before I was born, so I don't even know what he looks like.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Нет. Он ушёл ещё до моего рождения, так что я даже не знаю, как он выглядит.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: I've finally discovered that he's in this region, but that's all the information I have.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Я наконец узнала, что он в этом регионе, но это вся информация, что у меня есть.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: I see. In which case, Corneria, will you please tell us more about him?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Понятно. Тогда, Корнерия, расскажешь нам о нём побольше?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: We've been living here for all our lives. Maybe we can help you!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Мы всю жизнь живём здесь. Может, сможем помочь!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: Girls... Thank you so much. Let me see...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: Someone dressed in the same kind of clothing as you, and with the same copy power...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Кто-то в такой же одежде, как у тебя, и с такой же силой копирования...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: Hmm. I'm pretty sure I'd remember someone like that.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Хм. Почти уверена, что запомнила бы такого человека.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: Sorry, Corneria. It turns out we can't help you after all.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Прости, Корнерия. Оказывается, мы всё-таки не можем помочь.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: No, it's all right. I've been actively searching for him for more than ten years, after all.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Нет, всё в порядке. Ведь я активно ищу его уже больше десяти лет.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: But I'm not ready to give up yet.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Но я ещё не готова сдаться.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: Corneria, are you alright? You look completely exhausted!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Корнерия, ты в порядке? Ты выглядишь совершенно измотанной!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: Ah, I'm sorry... I should never let my customers see such weakness...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Ах, простите... Я никогда не должна позволять клиентам видеть такую слабость...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: I've been using my copying power too much recently. The two of you warned me about it, I know...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: В последнее время я слишком много пользовалась силой копирования. Вы двое предупреждали меня, я знаю...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: You can barely stand! You need to rest!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Ты едва стоишь! Тебе нужно отдохнуть!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: No. As a merchant, once the doors are open I can't close them until closing time...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Нет. Как торговец, я не могу закрыть двери после того, как они открыты, до самого закрытия...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: You take all this too seriously! Very well. At least let us get something for you.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Ты слишком серьёзно к этому относишься! Ладно. По крайней мере, позволь нам принести тебе что-нибудь.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: Ah, good idea! What do you want? We'll bring you whatever you need!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Ах, хорошая идея! Что ты хочешь? Мы принесём всё, что нужно!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: In which case, I'd like to drink some milk.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Тогда я бы хотела выпить молока.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: What? Milk? Like, from a cow?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: Are you sure that's all you want? Are you sure you're not taking it easy on us?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Ты уверена, что это всё? Уверена, что недооцениваешь нас?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: No, I'm not. I love milk, more than anything else.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Нет. Я люблю молоко больше всего на свете.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: In which case, it would be our pleasure. We'll bring you the most energizing milk ever!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Тогда нам будет только радостно. Принесём тебе самое бодрящее молоко!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Here you go, Corneria! Here's the milk you ordered, moooo!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Вот, Корнерия! Вот молоко, которое ты заказала, мууу!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Ah, that does look delicious! Let me get some of that right away!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Ах, выглядит вкусно! Дайте-ка мне сразу выпить!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Glug, glug, glug! Uwah!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Буль, буль, буль! О-о-ох!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Phew, I'm alive again! Thank you so much. I was about to shrink away to nothing!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Уф, я снова жива! Большое спасибо. Я уже собиралась сжаться в ничто!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Hahaha, is that the first time I've heard you make a joke? Is work going to make you shrink?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я впервые слышу, как ты шутишь? Работа заставит тебя сжаться?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: No. I'm not joking, unfortunately. That's the truth.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Нет. К сожалению, я не шучу. Это правда.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Excuse me?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Прошу прощения?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: There's a cost of my power. Each item I copy makes me shrink a little.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: У моей силы есть цена. Каждый скопированный предмет немного уменьшает меня.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: If I rest a little then it returns to normal, but if I'm not careful I'll stay tiny forever!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Если немного отдохну — всё вернётся в норму, но если не буду осторожна, навсегда останусь крошечной!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: What?! That's terrible!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Что?! Это ужасно!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: If you copy too much stuff, you'll be able to hide in the palm of my hand?!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Если скопируешь слишком много, сможешь уместиться у меня на ладони?!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: That might be cute, actually...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: На самом деле это может быть мило...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Sue, don't start that now. If that's the case, you should stop using that power, right away!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Сью, не начинай. Если так, тебе нужно немедленно прекратить пользоваться этой силой!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: No. I can't do that. It is one of the main services I offer.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Нет. Я не могу. Это одна из главных услуг, которые я предлагаю.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: But the cost is too great!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Но цена слишком велика!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: It's fine. If I can meet my father again, it's fine...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Всё в порядке. Если смогу снова встретиться с отцом — всё в порядке...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Oh...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Ох...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Running this shop, I might meet someone who knows my father.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Управляя этим магазином, я могу встретить кого-то, кто знает моего отца.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: If the shop becomes large and famous, my name may reach my father's ears.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Если магазин станет большим и известным, моё имя может дойти до ушей отца.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: So long as I have this shop, one day I'll be able to meet him. That's what I believe.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Пока у меня есть этот магазин, однажды я смогу с ним встретиться. Вот во что я верю.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: So no matter how small it makes me, I'm not about to stop copying items...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Поэтому, какой бы маленькой я ни становилась, я не собираюсь прекращать копировать предметы...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: We can't get involved in this, Lydie. You understand how Corneria feels, right?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Мы не можем в это вмешиваться, Лиди. Ты же понимаешь, что чувствует Корнерия, да?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Yes. I'm sorry, Corneria. I said too much.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Да. Прости, Корнерия. Я слишком много наговорила.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Hehe, you're very kind, Lydie. If you are worried about me, there's one thing you can do.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Хе-хе, ты очень добрая, Лиди. Если беспокоишься обо мне, есть одна вещь, которую ты можешь сделать.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Keep buying stuff from this shop! That's what will make me the happiest.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Продолжайте покупать в этом магазине! Вот что сделает меня самой счастливой.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Hahah! I see what you did there! So we just have to buy lots and lots of stuff, right?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Ха-ха! Поняла, к чему ты клонишь! Значит, нам просто нужно покупать много-много вещей, верно?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: It looks like it. I walked right into that one! Come on then, Corneria, what have you got?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Похоже на то. Видимо я попалась! Ну что ж, Корнерия, что у тебя есть?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Eh! Sophie, is that you?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Эх! Софи, это ты?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: What! Corneria?! Wow, it's been ages! How have you been?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Что! Корнерия?! Ух ты, сколько лет! Как ты?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Well, I haven't done much growing, but I'm fine. How are you doing, Sophie?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Ну, я не сильно выросла, но со мной всё в порядке. Как ты, Софи?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Hahaha, I'm fine. Plachta too, of course!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я в порядке. Плахта тоже, конечно!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: You sound so polite, Corneria! Have you grown up a little?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Ты говоришь так вежливо, Корнерия! Ты немного повзрослела?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Yes, I'm trying to be a bit more respectable. The old accent comes out every now and then, however!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Да, стараюсь быть чуть солиднее. Но старый акцент всё равно иногда прорывается!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Hello, Sophie. Are you doing some shopping at Corneria's store?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Здравствуй, Софи. Делаешь покупки в магазине Корнерии?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Hehehe, renewing old friendships, actually! Corneria and I have been friends for a long time!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Хе-хе-хе, вообще-то возобновляем старую дружбу! Мы с Корнерией дружим уже давно!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: We come from the same town. We've even adventured together.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Мы из одного города. Мы даже путешествовали вместе.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Wow, that's unexpected! The world is a smaller place than I thought!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Ух ты, неожиданно! Мир меньше, чем я думала!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Hehe, I guess you could say that. I'm happy to see Corneria again.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Хе-хе, можно и так сказать. Я рада снова увидеть Корнерию.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Say, Corneria. Have you found your father yet?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Скажи, Корнерия. Ты уже нашла своего отца?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: No, not yet... But my shop is still getting bigger.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Нет, ещё нет... Но мой магазин всё ещё растёт.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Yeah, the Corneria Enterprise! I know all about it! You've been working so hard, haven't you?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Да, Компания Корнерии! Я всё о ней знаю! Ты так много работала, правда?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Not that hard, haha! What about you, Sophie? You became a certified alchemist?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Не так уж и много, ха-ха! А ты, Софи? Стала сертифицированным алхимиком?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Yep, I totally did! I'm totally certified, from head to toe!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Ага, полностью! Сертифицирована с головы до ног!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: I see! Monika, Elise and a few of our friends were complaining about you never even visiting back home.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Понятно! Моника, Элиза и ещё несколько наших друзей жаловались, что ты даже не заезжаешь домой.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Monika even said she was going to head out herself and drag you back.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Моника даже сказала, что сама отправится и притащит тебя обратно.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Uwah, I don't like the sound of that! It has been a while since I visited Kirchen Bell, though...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Ух, мне это не нравится! Хотя и правда давно не была в Кирхенбелле...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: We've got so much to talk about. How about going for a drink?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Нам столько надо обсудить. Как насчёт выпить?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Yes, I'd like that very much. I'm quite a hard drinker, though, so watch out!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Да, с большим удовольствием! Но имей в виду, пью я много, так что берегись!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Hahaha, sounds like it's on now! See you later!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Ха-ха-ха, похоже, вызов принят! Увидимся позже!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Corneria, you looked very happy!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Корнерия, ты выглядела очень счастливой!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Of course. The reason I can have this shop is because of Sophie!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Конечно. Этот магазин у меня есть благодаря Софи!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: She hasn't changed at all, still so incredible! I wish I had half her conviction.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Она совсем не изменилась — всё такая же невероятная! Хотела бы я иметь хотя бы половину её решимости.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Hehe, I know! I want to be just like her, too.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Хе-хе, знаю! Я тоже хочу быть такой, как она.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..original: Corneria is listening to that music box again. Do you think she's thinking about her dad?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..translation: Корнерия снова слушает эту музыкальную шкатулку. Думаешь, она думает об отце?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..original: Probably. I can't believe she's never even seen his face! That's just so sad.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..translation: Наверное. Не могу поверить, что она даже никогда не видела его лица! Это так грустно.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..original: I know. I've got an idea, then! Let's really help her in the search for her dad!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..translation: Знаю. Тогда у меня идея! Давайте по-настоящему поможем ей искать папу!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..original: We know a lot about this region, after all. Let's ask around and collect some more information!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..translation: В конце концов, мы много знаем об этом регионе. Давайте поспрашиваем и соберём ещё информации!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..original: Yeah! For Corneria, let's do our best! Come on!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..translation: Ага! Ради Корнерии сделаем всё возможное! Вперёд!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..original: Huh? Lydie and Sue? I wonder what they are up to?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..translation: А? Лиди и Сью? Интересно, что они задумали?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..original: Hey, Mathias... There's a person we'd like to find.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..translation: Эй, Матиас... Нам бы хотелось найти одного человека.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..original: A man in strange clothes, who can multiply objects? I've never heard of such a person...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..translation: Мужчина в странной одежде, умеющий копировать предметы? Никогда о таком не слышал...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..original: That's a shame... I thought you'd have heard some rumors for sure, Mathias.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..translation: Жаль... Я думала, ты наверняка слышал какие-то слухи, Матиас.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..original: Hmm, okay. I'll ask around. Just don't expect too much!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..translation: Хм, ладно. Поспрашиваю. Только не ждите слишком многого!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..original: There should be at least rumors about someone who stands out that much, but I've never heard a thing.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..translation: О ком-то, кто так выделяется, должны быть хоть слухи, но я ничего не слышал.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..original: Yes, good point. Thank you, anyway.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..translation: Да, дельное замечание. Всё равно спасибо.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..original: Pamela? There's someone who we're looking for...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..translation: Памела? Есть человек, которого мы ищем...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..original: Someone who can copy items and wears strange clothing? Yes, I know who that is!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..translation: Кто-то, кто умеет копировать предметы и носит странную одежду? Да, я знаю, кто это!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..original: Hehehe. Her name is Corneria. We used to live in the same town, actually!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..translation: Хе-хе-хе. Её зовут Корнерия. Вообще-то мы жили в одном городе!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..original: I should have explained that better. We're actually looking for Corneria's dad.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..translation: Надо было объяснить лучше. На самом деле мы ищем отца Корнерии.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..original: Oh, is that so? I'm sorry, I don't know anything about her dad...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..translation: О, вот как? Простите, я ничего не знаю о её отце...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..original: I see. Alright, thank you. We'll try someone else.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..translation: Понятно. Хорошо, спасибо. Попробуем спросить у кого-нибудь другого.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..original: Mr. Fritz, excuse us, but we've got something to ask...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..translation: Мистер Фриц, извините, но нам нужно кое-что спросить...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..original: Oh? You're already aware of the issue?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..original: We're old friends. We searched for clues while we were traveling together, but...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..translation: Мы старые друзья. Мы искали улики, пока путешествовали вместе, но...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..original: We didn't find any information on her father, I'm afraid.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..translation: Боюсь, мы не нашли никакой информации о её отце.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..original: I see. Thanks for your time!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..original: Huh. So we didn't learn anything about Corneria's dad.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..translation: Хм. Так мы ничего не узнали об отце Корнерии.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..original: Yeah. It would've been really great to take some proper information back to her.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..translation: Ага. Было бы здорово принести ей хоть какую-то толковую информацию.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..original: I guess it can't be helped... Let's at least tell her that we're willing to help.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..translation: Ничего не поделаешь... Давай хотя бы скажем ей, что мы готовы помочь.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..original: Yeah, good idea. I'm sorry, Corneria.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Corneria... Uhm...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Корнерия... Эм...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Corneria! Have you got any bargains for me? Oh, hold on! I've heard this music before!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Корнерия! Есть для меня выгодные предложения? Ой, погоди! Я уже слышала эту музыку!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: What? The music from this box?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Что? Музыку из этой шкатулки?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Yeah, I think so.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Ага, кажется.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Where?! Where did you hear it?!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Где?! Где ты её слышала?!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: A village I visited on a walk... It was to the east of here, if I remember correctly!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: В деревне, куда я заходила на прогулке... К востоку отсюда, если правильно помню!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: There's only sea to the east!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: На востоке только море!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: What, is there? Then south, maybe? Or north-north-west?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Что, правда? Тогда на юг, может? Или на северо-северо-запад?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Oh my! We won't get any help from Drossel's terrible sense of direction.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: О боже! От ужасного чувства направления Дроссель нам не будет толку.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Hey, don't blame me. What's with the music box, anyway?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Эй, не вини меня. А что с музыкальной шкатулкой?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: You see...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Видишь ли...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Oh... I should have tried harder to remember the location!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Ох... Надо было лучше запомнить то место!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: There were loads of people there dressed just like Corneria!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Там было полно людей, одетых точно так же, как Корнерия!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: That sounds like exactly the place we want! Gah, I can't take this heartbreak!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Похоже, это как раз то место, которое нам нужно! Ах, не могу вынести этого горя!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: It's all right... If you can't remember, you can't remember. I'll just keep on running the shop...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Всё в порядке... Если не можешь вспомнить — не можешь. Я просто продолжу управлять магазином...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: No, hold on. Do you think you can trust me, Corneria?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Нет, погоди. Думаешь, ты можешь довериться мне, Корнерия?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Why do you ask?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Почему ты спрашиваешь?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: I'm going to go back to that place again!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Я снова отправлюсь в то место!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Hold on! Are you sure that's a good idea, Drossel?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Погоди! Ты уверена, что это хорошая идея, Дроссель?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Sure it is. I have a terrible sense of direction, but I'll get there in the end, I promise!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Конечно. У меня ужасное чувство направления, но в конце концов я доберусь, обещаю!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: You want to see your father, right, Corneria? That's what all your hard work has been for?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Ты хочешь увидеть отца, правда, Корнерия? Ради этого ты и трудилась?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Well, yes...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Ну да...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Family is important, and that's a fact. If I'm the only one who's been there, I have to go!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Семья важна, и это факт. Если я единственная, кто там был, мне нужно идти!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Leave this to me!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Оставьте это мне!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Very well. I want you to take this with you, then.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Хорошо. Тогда я хочу, чтобы ты взяла это с собой.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: A flyer?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Листовка?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Yes. For my store. Please give it to the people in that village.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Да. Моего магазина. Пожалуйста, отдай её жителям той деревни.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: My name was picked by my dad. So, if he is there in that village...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Имя мне выбрал отец. Так что если он там, в той деревне...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: He should recognize my name. Just give him that, that's all you need to do.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Он должен узнать моё имя. Просто отдай ему это — больше ничего не нужно.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: That's it? I could tell him to come?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Вот и всё? Я могла бы сказать ему прийти?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: No. I have my pride as a merchant. Please just promote my store, that's all.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Нет. У меня есть гордость торговки. Пожалуйста, просто рекламируй мой магазин — и всё.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Hahah, promote! I like that. Alright, you can count on me!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Ха-ха, реклама! Мне нравится. Хорошо, можешь на меня рассчитывать!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: She ran off in the opposite direction of the main gates, didn't she...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Она убежала в сторону, противоположную главным воротам, да...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Hahaha... It's okay. Drossel said to trust her, so that's all we can do...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Ничего. Дроссель сказала доверять ей — вот и всё, что мы можем сделать...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: You're right. I'll put my trust in you, then, Drossel!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Ты права. Тогда я доверюсь тебе, Дроссель!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Corneria... Drossel hasn't come back yet, has she?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Корнерия... Дроссель ещё не вернулась, да?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: No. But I will keep on waiting...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Нет. Но я буду продолжать ждать...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Wah, I almost ran past the place! That was close!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Ого, я чуть не пробежала мимо! Было близко!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Drossel! Welcome back. So?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Дроссель! С возвращением. Ну?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Hahah! The promotion was a big success! It just took a bit longer than I expected.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Ха-ха! Реклама имела огромный успех! Это заняло немного больше времени, чем я ожидала.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: T-Thank you so much! And my father?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Б-большое спасибо! А мой отец?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Hehe! There was this one person who reacted to the name at once, and even cried.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Хе-хе! Был один человек, который сразу отреагировал на имя и даже заплакал.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: I'm pretty sure that was your father, Corneria.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Почти уверена, что это был твой отец, Корнерия.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Really?!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Правда?!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: That settles it, doesn't it?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Значит, всё ясно, да?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Yes. We can only wait now and see if my father comes...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Да. Теперь остаётся только ждать, придёт ли мой отец...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Hahaha... It feels like we haven't done anything useful...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Такое чувство, что мы ничего полезного не сделали...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: No, that's not true.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Нет, это неправда.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: You told me about Corneria's shop in the first place.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Это вы с самого начала рассказали мне о магазине Корнерии.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Without your promotion, none of this would have happened!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Без вашей рекламы ничего бы этого не произошло!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: What do you say, Corneria? How about making these two your promotion agents?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Что скажешь, Корнерия? Как насчёт сделать этих двоих своими рекламными агентами?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Promotion agents? That sounds like a good idea. I think they may be perfectly suited.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Рекламные агенты? Звучит как хорошая идея. Думаю, они идеально подойдут.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: I don't mind! With my charm and my voice, I'll bring in more customers than you can handle!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Я не против! Своим обаянием и голосом привлеку больше клиентов, чем ты сможешь обслужить!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Hahaha, me too. If you'll let us do what we can between our other work, we'll help however we can!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я тоже. Если позволишь нам помогать между другими делами — поможем чем сможем!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Very well. I'll need to find something to reward you with, won't I?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Хорошо. Мне нужно будет найти, чем вас вознаградить, верно?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Lydie, Sue, and you, Drossel. Thank you so much for everything you've done!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Лиди, Сью и ты, Дроссель. Огромное спасибо за всё, что вы сделали!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Mysterious friendships, brought to me by my shop. I need to treasure them, going forward.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Таинственная дружба, которую принёс мне мой магазин. Нужно дорожить ею и дальше.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Peddler
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Boss! We're ready for our second Merveille store! Not a street stall, but a proper shop.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Босс! Мы готовы открыть наш второй магазин в Мервейле! Не уличный ларёк, а настоящий магазин.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: I told you not to call me "boss". How about "Chairwoman"?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Я же говорила тебе не называть меня «босс». Как насчёт «председатель»?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Peddler
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Of course, that's right! Chairwoman. I'll be more careful!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Конечно, верно! Председатель. Буду осторожнее!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Well then. With our second store, I'll be able to expand even more.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Ну что ж. Со вторым магазином я смогу расшириться ещё больше.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Hehe, Corneria! It looks like business is going well?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Хе-хе, Корнерия! Похоже, дела идут хорошо?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Hey, Lydie, Sue. Yes, thanks to you.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Эй, Лиди, Сью. Да, благодаря вам.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: We have a communications network and sales are up. Business in Adalet is going to be good.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: У нас налажена сеть снабжения, да и продажи растут. Дела в Адалете будут идти хорошо.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: I see, I see. And what about your dad?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Понятно, понятно. А что насчёт твоего отца?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: He hasn't come yet. But I can't afford to just sit around waiting.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Он ещё не пришёл. Но я не могу просто сидеть и ждать.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Of course, I want to see him. But growing my business is important too.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Конечно, я хочу его увидеть. Но развитие магазина тоже важно.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: That's the Corneria we know and love! Merchant among merchants!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Вот она, Корнерия, которую мы знаем и любим! Торговка среди торговцев!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Thank you so much. Hehe, I'll just keep on doing my best!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Большое спасибо. Хе-хе, буду и дальше стараться изо всех сил!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: To spread the name of Corneria Enterprise and supply as many as I can with affordable quality items!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Распространять имя Компании Корнерии и снабжать как можно больше людей доступными качественными товарами!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Great! We're supporting you, Corneria!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Отлично! Мы поддержим тебя, Корнерия!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Ah, I know. How about selling some of the stuff that we synthesize?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Ах, знаю. Как насчёт продажи кое-чего из того, что мы синтезируем?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: An interest rate around this, and then a low handling fee...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Процент где-то такой, и низкая комиссия за обработку...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Hah, I'm not just going to swallow that. Push the handling up a little higher...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Ха, я это так просто не проглочу. Поднимите комиссию чуть выше...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Hahaha, you two are negotiating already? Come on, Sue, we can't be taking so much of her time.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Ха-ха-ха, вы двое уже торгуетесь? Пойдём, Сью, нельзя отнимать у неё так много времени.
