ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Okay, okay. We'll continue this later, Corneria!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Ладно, ладно. Продолжим позже, Корнерия!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Very well. I look forward to it. See you later.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Хорошо. Жду с нетерпением. Увидимся позже.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: unknown(name_id=48)
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: ... Corneria? Is that really you?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: ...Корнерия? Это правда ты?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: What? ... Are you my father?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Что? ...Ты мой отец?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Thank goodness for that.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Слава богу.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: I know!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Знаю!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hello, girls! There's something I want to discuss with you.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Здравствуйте, девочки! Есть кое-что, что я хочу с вами обсудить.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: There is? What is it?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Да? Что именно?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: I've been reunited with my father. He came and visited my shop!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Я воссоединилась с отцом. Он пришёл и посетил мой магазин!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Ah, I knew it! Corneria, congratulations!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Ах, я так и знала! Корнерия, поздравляю!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: You must have had a lot to talk about. Did he tell you the reason why he left?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Вам, наверное, было о чём поговорить. Он рассказал, почему ушёл?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Yes. It was simple, really. Apparently, he copied too many things...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Да. На самом деле всё просто. Видимо, он слишком много чего скопировал...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Excuse me?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Прошу прощения?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: He took on a lot of work, for the sake of my mother, and shrunk down to a size of a bug!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Он взял на себя много работы ради моей матери и уменьшился до размеров жука!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Then my mother thought he had gone missing. It was all a misunderstanding, actually.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Потом мать подумала, что он пропал. На самом деле всё было недоразумением.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hahaha... I was only joking about becoming that small, but it's actually possible?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Я только шутила про то, чтобы стать такой маленькой, но это правда возможно?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: You be careful then, Corneria. We don't want Sue keeping you like a pet!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Тогда будь осторожна, Корнерия. Не хотим, чтобы Сью держала тебя как питомца!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hey, I'd never go that far! Although, if I actually saw her, my resolve...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Эй, я бы никогда так далеко не зашла! Хотя, если бы я её правда увидела, возможно...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hehe, I'll be careful, then. I don't want to end up as someone's pet, that's for sure.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Хе-хе, тогда буду осторожна. Точно не хочу стать чьим-то питомцем.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: So, where's your dad now?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Итак, где сейчас твой отец?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: He isn't in the city anymore. I gave him this.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Его больше нет в городе. Я дала ему это.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: What is it? A travel ticket?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Что это? Проездной билет?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Yes. A ticket back to my hometown, to Kirchen Bell.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Да. Билет обратно в мой родной город Кирхенбелл.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: There's so much more I want to talk to him about, but only when my mother is there too.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Мне ещё о многом хочется с ним поговорить, но только когда мама тоже будет рядом.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: I see! I'm sure she'll be happy about that! When will you be going back?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Понятно! Уверена, она будет рада! Когда ты вернёшься?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: It will be a while, I think.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Думаю, ещё нескоро.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Business is just getting on track here. I can't afford to step away at the moment.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Торговля здесь только набирает обороты. В данный момент я не могу позволить себе отстраниться от дел.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: What, are you sure? I think you need to get back there!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Что, ты уверена? По-моему, тебе нужно вернуться туда!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: A little punishment for making me wait for so long. This time he will have to wait for me.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Маленькое наказание за то, что заставил меня так долго ждать. На этот раз ему придётся ждать меня.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hehe, I can see that. I bet he'll wait as long as it takes.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Хе-хе, понимаю. Спорю, он будет ждать сколько угодно.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Thank you. I'll be relying on your patronage a little while longer, girls.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Спасибо. Ещё какое-то время буду рассчитывать на ваше покровительство, девочки.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Lydie, Sue. I hope you'll continue to come and visit the Corneria Enterprise!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Лиди, Сью. Надеюсь, вы и дальше будете заходить в Компанию Корнерии!
